subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Wanting something is easy.”?
options: Centuries later, it bought the town a new understanding of its past.
Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.
The responsibility stayed with the student.
Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Centuries later, it bought the town a new understanding of its past.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Wanting something is easy. Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Wanting something is easy. Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.」，答案為「Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Understanding responsibility before choosing is harder.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
